title: Warm Spicy Ethiopian Mixed Berries Ye Beg Alichia
description: A salty, chewy, and crowd-pleasing Ethiopian dish featuring frozen mixed berries, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional ye beg alichia, made macrobiotic-friendly and cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet. It is a dessert that combines the warmth of spices with the sweetness of mixed berries.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the thawed mixed berries, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries have broken down and the mixture has thickened.
Use an ice bath to shock the mixture and stop the cooking process.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then refrigerate it for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the ye beg alichia warm, garnished with additional mixed berries if desired.
